note:
MOD_PLAN.md section 6 item 37 (LEADS.md Part K), STRATA_CKPT_ASYNC=1 on HIP (default off, state placement only: exact text). The turn checkpoint (112.2 MiB GDN state, GPU->RAM) is synchronous on HIP inside every request's prompt time; with the switch, the device-to-device snapshot stays on the prompt path and the PCIe copy runs on a background thread into pinned memory (src/core/conversation_state.cpp, rules include/strata/program/ckpt_async_plan.hpp, host test ckpt_async_plan_test). STRATA_TRACE=1 on every arm prints 'strata trace: checkpoint at N: sync X ms, save Y ms' (read Y: base vs async). FIRST run the GPU ctest on the box: ctest -R conversation_snapshot_test (the _ckpt_async and _ckpt_vram_slots entries now run on HIP). Run: python3 tools/pancake/abtest.py bench/specs/140-hip-ckpt-async.json --tier screen. The abtest cases are one-shot requests (each still saves one checkpoint), so they show the prompt-time effect only. THEN the 10-turn TTFT scenario, the same form as spec 128 part 2: start the engine with the base command, python3 tools/pancake/ttft_bench.py --port

--scenario b --label base --out ttft-base.json; restart with STRATA_CKPT_ASYNC=1 and repeat with --label async; python3 tools/pancake/ttft_bench.py --compare ttft-base.json ttft-async.json. Equivalence: STRATA_CKPT_ASYNC=1 python3 tools/pancake/restore_check.py --control (the engine child inherits the environment; every turn must match the re-read arm within the control's noise). Read: save ms per checkpoint, prompt_ms of short/edit, TTFT per turn. The upper bound (spec 128, T-690) is the whole synchronous checkpoint, about 1.7% of agent turn time if HIP matches the CUDA comment (~70 ms); a gain above that bound is noise.
